name: F3c_arc_endpoint_chain_no_reverse
sw_rationale: Family 3 (Arc direction). An arc (CCW, start=0, end=90, r=10) whose start is coincident to a fixed line endpoint and whose end is coincident to another fixed point. After solving, the arc must have start=0 (touching (10,0)) and end=90 (touching (0,10)). If the solver accidentally reverses start/end, the coincident residuals would be satisfied with start pointing to (0,10) and end to (10,0) — a different topology. SolidWorks holds the user-intended orientation. Expected: start angle remains ~0 (or equivalent), end ~90. Confidence HIGH.

expect._coord_notes: Arc start angle must be ~0 deg (pointing to (10,0)), end must be ~90 deg (pointing to (0,10)). The arc winding must not reverse.
